description_for_human: Public Facebook + Instagram data via REST API — no OAuth, no app review.
description_for_model: SocialAPIs provides REST and MCP APIs for accessing public Facebook and Instagram data — pages, posts, marketplace listings, ads library, comments, profiles, reels. No OAuth required; auth is a single x-api-token header. Free tier: 200 calls/month, no credit card. Documentation: https://socialapis.io/api-sources. MCP server: https://socialapis.io/mcp.
